geometry.title: Genesis architecture: from plant reads to reviewed data
geometry.description: Prepared studies register local or public FASTQ reads, explicit references and optional input metadata review before deterministic Nextflow DAP-seq or paired-end bulk ATAC-seq pipelines. Peaks, signal tracks and QC reports are available before optional curation. Artifact validation, a scientific registry, policy QC and human review support reviewed exports. Optional external APIs or private LLM services exchange evidence and proposals with the registry and reviewers. Study plans drive the existing controller and local or authenticated SSH workers; successful outputs are collected with independent validation and review states. Solid arrows indicate data flow; dashed arrows indicate optional AI exchange, not execution or approval authority.
